verdict.rationale: Requesty's analytics dashboard tracks costs, requests, tokens, cache savings and latency in real time across models and providers, so the metrics the story asks for are present. The evidence describes aggregate usage analytics, though, not a log where individual requests and responses can be inspected with those metrics attached. Missing for 10: per-request log view with request/response payloads, documented per-request latency/token/cost fields, independent or hands-on corroboration.
